summary: BioHarvest Sciences filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, announcing a strategic leadership transition. Co-Founder and Executive Chairman Dr. Zaki Rakib assumes the role of CEO, consolidating R&D, manufacturing, and operations under the CDMO division. Ilan Sobel, former CEO since 2020, transitions to the Board of Directors to focus on D2C growth. No financial terms, advisor, or shareholder vote mentioned. This is a management change with no acquisition, tender, or restructuring. Watch for operational execution under the new unified structure.
